summary: Coconino County, AZ lookout site; a 1913 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts mentions a tower, FFLA lists ground gone, Peakbagging lists a LO site with building removed.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as ground and gone; the Peakbagging table labels it a lookout site where the building has been removed; a 1913 item describes a tower, so the structure type conflicts

events.note: Newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts: work was starting on a tower just south of Winslow on Chevelon Butte, and the lookout had been connected by telephone. The item does not say whether the tower was finished.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts names the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest; the 1913 item calls it the Sitgreaves National Forest, and the Forest Service now uses the Apache-Sitgreaves name

notes_for_editor: Unresolved structure-type conflict: the 1913 item speaks of a tower, while FFLA lists Ground. Peakbagging calls it a LO site (building removed) at 6945 ft. Leads not used because they were not read: a HikeArizona photo caption, seen only as a search snippet, says remnants of an old fire watch tower were reported dismantled by survey crews in 1974; HikeArizona returned HTTP 403 and surgent.net has an expired certificate. Another HikeArizona trip note mentions an old lookout's remnants near O'Haco, which may be a different structure; do not conflate. The Forest Service page read does not mention a 1974 merger, so no merger date is claimed. No source read gives a build date, staffing, fires, or visit access. The 1913 item's quoted text joins two sentences without punctuation. Fact-check 2026-10-10: no page read mentions visiting, access or permission; the story now says only that none of the sources read does.
